Alex — perfect, thanks. I’ve included Marissa (SE) on this thread. She’ll run the technical deep dive on Wed 3/22 at 10:00 AM PT.

Answers (top-level) to your questions — we’ll go deeper in the call and share architecture notes in advance:
- Customer-managed KMS: yes, Redwood Private supports AWS KMS integration with customer-managed keys and HSM-backed keys. We can validate key rotation policies and required IAM roles during the review.
- IP allowlist: for VPC deployments we provide a documented set of egress IP ranges per region and per deployment; if you need a fixed single IP we can discuss dedicated NAT/bastion approaches in Dedicated setups.
- Air-gapped on-prem: we offer an on-prem package that supports air-gapped installs. Control plane features are optional — the on-prem package can operate fully offline with manual artifact transfer and local telemetry collection.

Meeting details:
- When: Wed Mar 22, 2028 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Where: Google Meet (calendar invite to follow)
- Agenda (30–45 min tech deep dive + 15 min procurement/next steps):
  - Architecture walk (VPC + network flows)
  - KMS and key management options
  - Deployment variants: hosted vs dedicated vs on-prem air-gapped
  - Action items & procurement checklist

I’ll send a calendar invite shortly and include the sharepoint link to our Private deployment checklist. If there’s anything else you want covered, let us know.

Best,
Nikhil
